mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS registrationId, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.team_display_name AS teamDisplayName, s.id AS submissionId, s.anonymous_code AS anonymousCode, s.eligibility_status AS eligibilityStatus, s.eligibility_reason AS eligibilityReason, s.locked_version_id AS lockedVersionId, COALESCE(v.title, (SELECT t.title FROM submission_version t WHERE t.submission_id=s.id ORDER BY t.version_no DESC LIMIT 1)) AS title FROM registration r LEFT JOIN submission s ON s.registration_id=r.id LEFT JOIN submission_version v ON v.id=s.locked_version_id WHERE r.competition_id=#{competitionId} AND r.status='APPROVED' ORDER BY r.id
mapper.sql: p.id, p.competition_id AS competitionId, p.version_no AS versionNo, p.publication_type AS publicationType, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.published_by AS publishedBy, p.no_awards AS noAwards, p.correction_reason AS correctionReason, p.id=c.current_publication_id AS currentBatch
mapper.select: SELECT FROM result_publication p JOIN competition c ON c.id=p.competition_id WHERE p.competition_id=#{competitionId} ORDER BY p.version_no DESC
SELECT id, request_hash AS requestHash FROM result_publication WHERE competition_id=#{competitionId} AND request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT registration_id AS registrationId, work_title_snapshot AS workTitle, entry_display_snapshot AS entryDisplay, outcome_status AS outcomeStatus, outcome_reason AS outcomeReason, CAST(total_score AS CHAR) AS totalScore, rank_no AS rankNo, award_name AS awardName, recipient_names_snapshot AS recipientNames FROM competition_result WHERE publication_id=#{publicationId} ORDER BY rank_no IS NULL, rank_no, registration_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO result_publication(competition_id, version_no, published_by, published_at, correction_reason, publication_type, no_awards, request_id, request_hash, scoring_basis) VALUES(#{competitionId}, #{versionNo}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{reason}, #{mode}, #{noAwards}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{basis})

INSERT INTO competition_result(publication_id, registration_id, competition_id, work_title_snapshot, entry_display_snapshot, outcome_status, outcome_reason, total_score, rank_no, award_name, recipient_names_snapshot) VALUES(#{publicationId}, #{registrationId}, #{competitionId}, #{workTitle}, #{entryDisplay}, #{outcomeStatus}, #{outcomeReason}, #{totalScore}, #{rankNo}, #{awardName}, #{recipientNamesJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE competition SET current_publication_id=#{publicationId}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{competitionId}
